summary: The strip is almost static across all 8 frames, with no pops or render flicker, but the blade is held up beside his face and he looks at the camera instead of at it.

faults.what: The idea is that he looks at the blade and closes his fist around it. In these frames his eyes and head face the camera, and the blade is a thin stick beside his cheek. The fist is already mostly closed, so the slow close has no visible start.
faults.fix: Turn his head and eyes down to the blade, and start with the hand open so the fist can close slowly.

faults.what: The blade is a thin green-and-dark sliver held at the edge of the fingers right next to his face. Its grip is hard to read and it sits close to the cheek.
faults.fix: Move the hand away from the face and wrap the fingers visibly around the blade.

faults.what: The pose is nearly frozen across all 8 frames. His other arm is stiff, with the hand hanging on his hip, and there is no breathing or settle.
faults.fix: Add a slight weight shift or a head drift into the held pose.
